name: Wrocław
tagline: Islands, bridges and hundreds of bronze dwarfs
summary: Wrocław is a city of islands and bridges on the Oder, with one of Europe's finest market squares. Hunt for the 600 tiny bronze dwarfs hidden around town, see the lamplighter on Ostrów Tumski at dusk, walk into the 114 m Racławice Panorama painting and climb the cathedral towers.
seasonNote: Summer is lively; the Christmas market is one of Poland's best.
arrival: Trains from Kraków take 3 hours, from Berlin about 4h30; the airport is 30 minutes by bus.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; trams for the rest.
cashTip: Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere. Tip about 10 percent in restaurants.
foodTip: Pierogi, żurek sour rye soup in bread, and craft beer from Świdnicka Cellar.
